title: Special Report: Where 7-OH Stands With the DEA
subject: 🚨 7-OH: the DEA can schedule it as soon as Nov 13. What's covered, and how to prepare
preheader: The DEA's Oct 14 notice in plain English: the two-part test, what is NOT changing (natural leaf), and checklists for shops and consumers.
intro: This is an urgent federal update, and the whole report is below so you don't have to click anywhere. On October 14 the DEA filed notice that it will place 7-OH in Schedule I above a set level, as soon as November 13. Natural leaf is not affected federally. Please share it with anyone who sells or uses 7-OH products.
